symptom: A Java action, JavaScript action or microflow **silently loses its Studio Pro toolbox entry** on an unrelated rewrite. Two shapes: with `exposed as …` kept, the icon and image PNGs come back as empty binaries; with the clause omitted, the whole entry disappears — caption, category, icon and image — and the action vanishes from the palette. `mx check` reports **0 errors** in both cases
cause: `CodeActions$MicroflowActionInfo` has six fields (Caption, Category, IconData, IconDataDark, ImageData, ImageDataDark) and MDL's clause names two, so the write path *constructed* the sub-document from the clause instead of merging onto the stored one. Compounded on the default engine by a read that never loaded the bitmaps: `modelsdk/gen` declares all four as `string` while Mendix stores BSON **binary**, so `DecodeString` returned `""` for every real icon — the same gen/storage mismatch class as scheduled events and regular expressions
insight: **Silence is preservation, not removal** — an absent clause must carry the stored value, so removing needs its own syntax (`NOT EXPOSED`, `DROP ICON`). Rebuilding a sub-document from the subset MDL can express is the general shape of this bug (ADR-0005); look for `X = &T{...}` where `X` is a stored polymorphic child. **Check the READ before blaming the write**: a merge cannot carry what the reader never loaded, and a gen accessor typed `string` over a BSON binary fails silently to `""`. **Two microflow renderers exist** in `cmd_microflows_show.go` (`describeMicroflow` and `renderMicroflowMDL`) — patching one leaves DESCRIBE unchanged on the path the CLI actually takes. A test fixture generating two same-sized PNGs produces **identical bytes**, so an "each target is routed separately" assertion passes vacuously unless the fixtures differ
